Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 5 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 5, 12:03 PM ET

Trevor Lawrence has the highest SPAGS projection in the Jaguars at Ravens DraftKings Showdown: 18.0 points at $10,600 FLEX, 27.0 at captain for $15,900. Across 100,000 simulations Lawrence holds 82% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Lawrence is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.7 points at a $10,600 FLEX salary, in a game with a 39.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 24.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Lawrence at captain. Parker Washington is the next captain in line, at 17.2%. The model gives him 6.3 targets on 22.7 routes.

Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.75 for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens.

Behind Lawrence and Washington, the next projections are Chris Rodriguez Jr. (14.8, $3,400), Derrick Henry (12.7, $10,200) and Zay Flowers (11.9, $10,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 5, 12:03 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Trevor Lawrence, JAX QB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Trevor Lawrence holds 24.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 18.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.6 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Lawrence averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 36.8. He holds 82% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 24.1% as the captain and 57.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Parker Washington, JAX WR ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Parker Washington holds 17.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 14.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 21.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.3 targets on 22.7 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Washington averaged 14.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 39.8. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.2% as the captain and 32.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Chris Rodriguez Jr., JAX RB ($3,400 FLEX / $5,100 CPT)

Chris Rodriguez Jr. holds 14.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $5,100 and the 14.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 21.2 carries and 1.6 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Rodriguez averaged 14.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.3 and a ceiling of 29.1. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.8% as the captain and 54.8% in a FLEX spot.

Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations Hill averaged 7.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.2 and a ceiling of 14.1. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.1% as the captain and 20.1% in a FLEX spot.

Ravens projects for 4.6 DraftKings points at a $3,000 FLEX salary, 1.55 projected points per $1,000. Across 100,000 simulations Ravens averaged 4.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.7. Trevor Lawrence is the most expensive player at $10,600 FLEX and $15,900 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.
